claims: …rograde equatorial jet and prograde jets at high latitude (Vasavada and Showman 2005; Smith et al. 1989). Equatorial speed factors are a cartoon (docs/fudges.md).

Neptune's Great Dark Spot, an anticyclone near 22 degrees S about 13000 km across with bright companion clouds (Smith et al. 1989); such spots last years. Rate (0.2 a year) and life (log-uniform 1 to 6 years) tuned (docs/fudges.md).
